title: Community Helpers — Serving Others Like Jesus
memory_verse: "Serve one another humbly in love." — Galatians 5:13 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about community helpers and how they serve others the way Jesus taught us to serve.
content: Community helpers are people who work to keep our town safe, healthy, and running smoothly. They serve others every day!
Police officers keep us safe. Firefighters put out fires and rescue people. Doctors and nurses help us when we are sick.
Teachers help us learn. Mail carriers bring our letters. Trash collectors keep our streets clean. Every helper has an important job.
Jesus told us to love and serve one another. Community helpers do this every day. We can thank God for the helpers in our community and pray for them.
activity: Draw a picture of your favorite community helper. Write a thank-you note to a community helper in your town.
discussion: Who are some community helpers you know?
How do community helpers serve others like Jesus?
How can you be a helper in your community?
